Team project with Solbee Kim and John Vasconcelos: **VA Budget, FY2008–FY2026**.

The dashboard asks how the executive and legislative branches differ in funding the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. The RQ1 and RQ2 pages run R in the browser (Shinylive), so the first load takes 10–30 seconds.
